questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most 50+ Scores' in the 19/20 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Tazmin Brits holds it, with a total of 3.

questions.question: Who topped the runs charts in the 18/19 season (T20)?
At which ground did Dolphins record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — largest win by runs of 301, against Limpopo Lillies on 2017/11/11.

questions.question: At which ground did Esmarelda Olivier record their career-best bowling figures (4-18, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Potchefstroom Oval, against Knights on 2019/11/24.

questions.question: Laura Wolvaardt became the first South African woman to reach 5,000 ODI runs. In how many innings did she reach the milestone, the second-fastest ever?
questions.explanation: Wolvaardt reached 5,000 ODI runs in 117 innings, second only to India's Smriti Mandhana (112 innings).
